Progeni Bench

Privacy Policy

1. The Zero-Upload Guarantee

Progeni Bench is designed from the ground up as a client-side execution platform. When you use our bookmark cleaners, CSV tools, image converters, subtitle editors, or calendar organizers:

  • Your uploaded files are loaded into your browser's local memory (RAM) via standard HTML5 File APIs.
  • Calculations and conversions run on your device's CPU/GPU.
  • Generated outputs are downloaded directly to your disk.
  • None of your files, images, or document contents are ever sent to our servers or stored on remote databases.

2. Zero Third-Party Tracking

Progeni Bench does not embed third-party advertising tracking scripts or behavioral profilers. All utility tools function entirely offline once loaded into your web browser.

Progeni Bench is a Progeni project — Small file jobs, done privately in your browser.
